headline: Trump suggests Apple's Tim Cook as Nvidia's next CEO
dek: The pick came on Truth Social, per TechCrunch and Hipertextual.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: The suggestion
body: Trump suggested Tim Cook to replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia, in a Truth Social post, per TechCrunch and Hipertextual.
He called it "one legend replacing another" (TechCrunch).

points.t: Stepped down as CEO on Sept. 1.
He is executive chairman of the board.
Sonnenfeld backed the idea in Time.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Doubts
body: TechCrunch says it is unclear whether Trump truly backs the idea.
Hipertextual notes Cook is not a product-focused executive, as Huang was.

items.t: The pick does not change the process (TechCrunch).
Nothing says Cook wants to leave (Hipertextual).

caption.hook: Trump suggested Apple's Tim Cook as Nvidia's new CEO, hours after Huang resigned.
body: Per TechCrunch and Hipertextual, the US president posted on Truth Social that only one man could take the job, and described the swap as one legend replacing another. Cook stepped down as Apple CEO on Sept. 1 after 15 years and is now executive chairman, per TechCrunch.

TechCrunch says it is unclear whether Trump truly backs the idea, and that the suggestion does not change Nvidia's official succession process. Hipertextual notes Cook is not a product-focused executive, as Huang was, and that there is no sign he wants to leave Apple.
